source.title: Belfast News-Letter, 5 May 1955, p. 6 ("Urban council nominations: Carrickfergus (aldermen returned unopposed)"); Irish News, 5 May 1955, p. 5 ("Carrickfergus: returned unopposed"); Belfast News-Letter, 16 June 1949, p. 5 ("Result of Carrickfergus contests 1949")
source.publisher: Belfast News-Letter (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: returned unopposed as alderman: 'The following aldermen have been returned unopposed:—Messrs. T. J. Patterson, Daniel Blair, K. G. Hogsett, and W. M'Keown' (BNL 5 May 1955 p. 6)

note: Municipal elections, 18 May 1955; contests in four wards for eight seats. Four aldermen were returned unopposed (BNL 5 May 1955 p. 6); their wards are inferred from earlier returns (see each contest). Two further members, Mrs M. Beattie and Mrs A. Doherty, were also returned unopposed (Irish News, 5 May 1955, p. 5), but no source found places them in a ward or says whether they were aldermen or councillors, so they are not shown against a ward (gap-fill 6 Nov 2026). Division inferred from the 15 June 1949 return (East Central Ward alderman: Daniel Blair elected); the Belfast News-Letter of 5 May 1955 p. 6 names the member as returned (unopposed alderman) but not his ward. The four unopposed aldermen fill exactly the four wards without an aldermanic contest (North and West Central were contested). Returned unopposed.
